metadata.title: Operator-Host Compatibility for IVF Intensification - PPSN 2026 reproducibility artifact (rev1)
metadata.description: Reproducibility artifact for the PPSN 2026 paper 'Operator-Host Compatibility in Multi-Objective Intensification: IVF Across SPEA2, NSGA-II, and NSGA-III'. Contains the processed per-run endpoint metrics, dynamic trajectories, LaTeX tables, figure PDFs, and Python analysis scripts needed to reproduce every summary reported in the paper.
